items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I had played with him at one or two jobs when the Sirens put on some extra men

ctx.x: This is Russ, yes. He was from Nanticoke. I should mention that. And I had played with him at one or two jobs when the Sirens put on some extra men and he was playing, he and Fuzzy Farrar at the Armory, Scranton Armory, so and besides I knew him when he played a couple of jobs around Wilkes Barre, you know, admired his work, his trombone playing and all this (inaudible).

So I never played with him too much, but I knew him and I played with him a few times, but he was conducting the band then. He wasn't playing with the Goldkette band, they had Bill Rank and Spiegel (Newell Willcox -- ed.) and he said, "Why don't you have this guy make some arrangements for you?" he said to Charlie, and he said, "Okay, what do you want to do."
